title: Signed Webhook Delivery
signature:
def sign(secret, timestamp, body) -> str
def verify(secret, header, body, now, tolerance=300) -> str
class Receiver: __init__(secret, tolerance=300), handle(header, body, now) -> int, processed: list
def deliver(event, secret, send, clock, schedule) -> dict
hints: The signed payload is the exact string f"{t}.{body}". Verify against the raw body you received, never a re-serialized copy.
Parse every comma-separated key=value pair. Accept the header if any v1 matches (compare with hmac.compare_digest), then check |now - t| <= tolerance in both directions.
Sign inside the retry loop. A signature made before a 30-minute backoff is stale by the time it arrives.
The receiver remembers event ids it has processed and answers 200 to a repeat without processing it again.
